name: Pack One
subtitle: Daily Limited Draft Challenge
promotionalText: Three daily challenges. Eight draft picks each. Compare your choices with trophy drafters and see how you stack up against other players.
description:
Would you make the same pick as a trophy drafter?

Pack One turns real trophy drafts into a daily draft challenge. Make your picks, see what the original drafter chose, and find out what the model thinks.

Every run has eight decisions taken from real trophy drafts. You'll see the pack and the cards the drafter had already picked. Make your choice before the reveal.

Three new challenges every day

Daily Draft Run, Daily Powered Cube, and Daily Latest Set. Everyone plays the same decisions, so you can compare your score with other players on the leaderboards.

The trophy drafter isn't always right

Matching the trophy pick earns full points, but strong alternatives can earn partial credit. Review your decisions and see where you agreed - or disagreed - with the drafter and the model.

Keep drafting

Play regular practice runs between Dailies, follow your results over time, and see how your drafting compares with other players.

All three Dailies are free, with no account required. A free account adds leaderboards, career history, and synchronization across iPhone, iPad, and packone.pro. Optional Elite membership unlocks additional practice options.
